svg.title: Bulk Micromagnetic Exchange: Continuum Model, FDM Stencil, and FEM Weak Form
svg.desc: Three-panel comparison of bulk micromagnetic exchange in Fullmag: (a) continuum variational energy and natural homogeneous Neumann boundary condition, (b) finite-difference 6-neighbor stencil with inactive-cell clamping and FP64 T0/T1 sub-cell corrections, and (c) conforming P1 H1 finite-element weak form with lumped and consistent mass projections.
svg.text: Bulk Micromagnetic Exchange: Continuum Model, FDM Stencil, and FEM Weak Form
Shared continuum energy Eex = ∫ A ‖∇m‖² dV vs discrete 6-neighbor FDM clamping and conforming P1 H¹(Ωm) FEM realization
Bulk energy Eex and free-surface Neumann law
RKKY, surface, and Dirichlet BCs are separate.
Clamped free-surface Neumann closure and FP64 T0/T1 sub-cell lanes
Standard 6-Neighbor Field & Energy (CPU Ref / CUDA FP64, FP32)
Hex,iq = (2 / μ0 Ms) Σj∈N_6(i) Ar_i r_j (mjq − miq) / Δij²
Eex,h = Σi Σd = +x,+y,+z Ar_i r_j φi Vi ‖mj − mi‖² / Δd²
CPU SoA uses scalar A; CUDA uses explicit LUT Ar_i r_j.
FP32 computes field in float, accumulates energy in FP64.
FDM GPU Sub-Cell Corrections (FP64 Only; FP32 Rejects)
T0: HiT0 = 2/(μ0 Ms φeff) Σj Aij fi→j (mj−mi)/Δij²
T1: Hi←jT1 = 4 Aij(mj−mi) / (μ0 Ms φeff Δd [Δd + δeff])
where φeff = max(φi, φfloor), δeff = max(δi,−d, δmin)
No PBC on T0/T1; multilayer CUDA has no cross-layer exchange.
Tetrahedral/P1 stiffness assembly KA and mass projection
MFEM Legacy Assembly & CUDA CSR Projection
Eex,h = Σq = x,y,z mqT KA mq (symmetric graph Laplacian)
Lumped Mass Projection (FEM CPU Default & FEM GPU FP64 CSR):
Consistent Mass Projection (FEM CPU CG only, rtol=10⁻¹⁰):
MM_s qq = KA mq, Hex,q = −(2 / μ0) qq
• Natural A ∂n m = 0 arises automatically from ∫ A ∇m : ∇η dV.
• Conforming H¹ enforces continuous m across material interfaces.
